name: pokemanion
description: A Pokemon in a terminal pane beside every session, resting while the agent waits and animating while it works.

interface.shortDescription: A Pokemon that shows when your agent is working
interface.longDescription: A Pokemon lives in a terminal pane beside every session. It rests while the agent waits on you and animates while it works, so you can tell what a session is doing without reading the screen. 17 ship with it and 1241 more can be summoned by name. macOS + Ghostty.
